title: Miron
creator: CrossFit
description: Five rounds of an 800 m run, 23 back squats at three-quarter bodyweight and 13 deadlifts at 1.5x bodyweight, for time. Honours Polish Army Sgt. Maj. Miroslaw 'Miron' Lucki, killed by an IED in Ghazni Province, Afghanistan, in 2013. Loads are relative to your own bodyweight, so set them before you start.
